DESCRIPTION FOR PET PLANTER:
To create a distinctive 3D-printable planter, focus on replicating the minimalist, geometric shapes of this design. The round head and ears, combined with a compact body and simple tail, are key features. Opt for a standing pose with a planter cavity on the back. This will ensure stability while preserving the pet's recognizable abstract character. The solid color and simplistic shapes should be maintained for an effective translation to a decorative planter.
